citationText: A.C. Kokaram, R.D. Morris, W.J. Fitzgerald, and P. J. W. Rayner, “Interpolation of Missing Data in Image Sequences,” IEEE Trans. Image Processing, 4(11):1509-1519, Nov. 1995. First presented at IBC 2014, Amsterdam, The Netherlands, 11-15 September 2014. This paper is published here by kind permission of the IBC. Copyright © IBC. THE AUTHORS Sungwoo Choi is a research engineer at the Technical Research Institute of Korean Broadcasting System. He received a bachelor’s degree of industrial and management engineering from Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) in 2005, and a master’s degree in image processing from Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) in 2010. His research interests include image processing techniques for broadcasting and multimedia services with smart devices.
